notes: No SciPy optimizer is used by the accepted replay commands.
Optional diagnostic jet checks in flow_scalar_sensitivity.py use SymPy but are not part of this replay.
Interval checks assume ordinary IEEE-754 binary64 with NumPy nextafter; each arithmetic operation is enclosed outward.

groups.foundational: Universal rational bounds, current normal form, Slater, compact constants, terminal curvature
groups.localization: Exact ordered-242 reference coefficients and absorbed first variation
groups.selected_upper: Strict selected-family feasible trial at L=.56232847
groups.regularity: Contact, diagonal invariant bands, retained slack and support constants
groups.binary: Complete binary and coupled contact/Hermite construction

replay_policy.execution: serial separate Python subprocesses; never import checker modules into the runner
replay_policy.group_dependencies: Group-only runs use the supplied prerequisite certificate files. Add --with-dependencies to replay their certificate generators too.
replay_policy.outputs: Replay overwrites declared result files; imported exact helpers can also refresh auxiliary result JSON. Logs are retained separately.
replay_policy.hashes: Archival hashes, not expected timing-dependent output equality. Refresh deliberately after final proof edits with --refresh-hashes.
replay_policy.proof_scope: Arithmetic replay does not replace the companion analytic hypotheses or prove that a numerical reference is optimal.
replay_policy.dependency_meaning: depends_on records certificate-generator replay dependencies. Python module imports and certificate/data inputs are listed separately. The analytic order and conditional hypotheses are in the definitive proof, not encoded as a complete theorem dependency DAG.

verification_runtime.arithmetic: Fraction and outward-rounded binary64 interval operations
